svg.title: The improvement cycle of a support team
svg.desc: Cycle of 5 steps: 1 Collect tickets (every channel); 2 Find patterns (weekly); 3 Fix the cause; 4 Write it down; 5 Train the team; the last leads back to Collect tickets. Roles: critical: Fix the cause; planned: Train the team.
svg.text: The improvement cycle of a support team

polyline.title: Fix the cause → Write it down
Write it down → Train the team
